commands_once_keys_provided.curl_first_span_webhook_doctor_shape: curl -sS -w '\nhttp:%{http_code}\n' -X POST "$EDEN_BASE_URL/orgs/$EDEN_ORG_ID/ingest/webhook" -H "X-Org-Id: $EDEN_ORG_ID" -H "X-Org-Api-Key: ${EDEN_ORG_API_KEY:-$EDEN_API_KEY}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '[{"event_id":"live_doctor_1","event_type":"agent.run","name":"eden.doctor","trace_id":"'"$(uuidgen | tr -d - | tr A-Z a-z)"'","outcome":"success","duration_ms":0,"attributes":{"doctor":true},"tags":["doctor","sdk"],"source_format":"eden-sdk-doctor"}]'
